blocks.text: Stoichiometry is very important in the field of medicine and is used to:

items: In the preparation of antibiotics, the stoichiometry ensures that each dose matches the active ingredient and target bacteria.
To determine the cholesterol level in the blood of patients. Cholesterol is a form of fat that is not all bad. However, cholesterol can have harmful effects.
To determine the glucose level in the blood of diabetic patient. Use of insulin relies on the stoichiometry to precise control of blood sugar levels.
To determine the steroid and other stimulants in the urine of athletes. Athletes use steroids and other stimulants to enhance performance and increase strength.
To determine the concentration of viral antigens in the preparation of vaccine for effective results.

To determine the amount and number of drugs to give a dosage to a patient. The medicine has no effect when given in small amounts and can cause toxic state or death when given in large amounts. Paracetamol is used as a pain killer and to decrease fever. An overdose may result a blood thinning, organ damage and severe liver damage.
